purpose: Eliminate silent scheduled-run loss by persisting liveness before any variable-latency research/audit call, then enriching the same RUN_ID only if budget remains.

root_cause_basis.root_cause: Authoritative persistence occurred after variable-latency work calls, allowing scheduler termination before any durable write.

transaction: Fetch only <lane>/latest.json and retain its blob SHA as PREVIOUS_BLOB_SHA.

Immediately write phase-1 receipt for a fresh RUN_ID using PREVIOUS_BLOB_SHA. Required phase-1 values: RUN_STATUS=RUN_PERSISTED, FINALIZATION_STATUS=LIVENESS_VERIFIED, WORK_PHASE_STATUS=PENDING, verification_method=GITHUB_CONTENTS_CAS_UPDATE_RESPONSE, run_origin=NATURAL_SCHEDULE. Use commit message containing [skip ci].
Use the phase-1 update response content_sha as PHASE1_BLOB_SHA. Do not read back.
Perform at most one bounded work call. If it fails, is incomplete, or consumes the remaining runtime, stop; phase-1 liveness remains authoritative transport evidence.

If work completes, update the same <lane>/latest.json exactly once more using PHASE1_BLOB_SHA. Preserve the same RUN_ID, set FINALIZATION_STATUS=VERIFIED and WORK_PHASE_STATUS=COMPLETED or DEGRADED_COMPLETED, and include the truthful work delta. This second commit may run CI.
Never retry either mutation inside the same scheduled execution.

scheduler_jitter.rule: scheduled_for is the nominal slot; actual start jitter within tolerance does not invalidate the run.

legacy_artifacts.v4_0_and_v4_1: historical receipts; do not count toward v4.2 consecutive acceptance

acceptance.transport_success: Natural v4.2 LIVENESS_VERIFIED phase-1 receipt exists.
acceptance.full_run_success: Same RUN_ID upgraded to FINALIZATION_STATUS=VERIFIED with WORK_PHASE_STATUS completed/degraded-completed.
acceptance.sustained_lane: Two consecutive natural fully VERIFIED v4.2 RUN_IDs with distinct blob SHAs.
acceptance.stack_5_of_5: All five lanes satisfy sustained_lane while exactly five authoritative tasks remain enabled.
